blast.title: Every chat just starts.
blast.lead: Live Chat and group chats start reliably and reply faster, and you can now choose your Sims' AI right from Live Chat.
points: A world that keeps living: sims living their own lives keep looking after themselves and seeking each other out…
Chats start every time: live Chat and group chats no longer stall or fail when several Sims are living their own lives.
Faster first replies: even a Sim's very first conversation answers quickly.
